description:
MEASURED s492c (Opus, 2026-09-21) while doing #2050, and it CORRECTS that
task's premise.

#2050 said Text::Wrap's main loop is `/\G((?:(?=[^\n])\X){0,$ll}).../` and
that `\X` was the blocker.  That is an OLDER Text::Wrap.  perl 5.40.3's is

    /\G((?>(?!\n)\PM\pM*|(?<![^\n])\pM+){0,$ll})($break|\n+|\z)/xmgc

and `our $break = '(?>\n|\r\n|'.$brkspc.'\pM*)'`, so it is `\pM`/`\PM` -- the
Unicode Mark property -- that Text::Wrap needs.  s492c DID implement `\X`
(and `\N`), which were real silent never-matches, but wrap()/fill() still die
"This shouldn't happen".

THE MEASUREMENT (the thing this task exists for):

  * PCL's vendored cl-ppcre HAS the hook: `cl-ppcre:*property-resolver*`
    (cl/vendor/cl-ppcre/specials.lisp:138, used at lexer.lisp:338/619 and
    convert.lisp:78).  It is a variable holding a function from a property
    NAME to a character test.
  * PCL NEVER SETS IT (grep: no occurrence anywhere in cl/pcl-runtime.lisp),
    so `\p{...}` reaches cl-ppcre with a nil resolver and the pattern silently
    fails to match -- probed: `"\x{301}" =~ /\p{M}/` is FALSE here, TRUE in
    perl, and `"abc" =~ /\p{L}/` is false here too.
  * `sb-unicode:general-category` is the primitive a resolver would use; the
    common perl names (L, Lu, Ll, N, Nd, M, Mn, P, S, Z, C and the
    Alpha/Alnum/Word/Space aliases) are a short table over it.
  * docs/not-supported.md's deferred-property section CLAIMS PCL does
    "regex properties through cl-ppcre's property support" -- it does not,
    and s492c corrected that text.

RELATION TO #1036: that task defers the ~370,000-row FULL TABLE class (case
folding, every property perl's tables carry).  A general-category resolver is
not that: it is one function over sb-unicode, and it would unblock a CORE
MODULE.  Worth costing separately -- and it needs the full sweep plus the re/
companion legs, because patterns that today never match would start matching.


=== s496 (Fable, 2026-09-25): BRIEF WRITTEN -- ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s496/s496a/prompt.md (label s496a, IDs 2380-2399).  MEASUREMENTS on disk (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s496/ppcre-probe.lisp, base-prop.pl, prop-files.txt):
  * setting cl-ppcre:*property-resolver* makes \p{M} match U+0301; \P{M}, [\p{L}\d], [^\p{L}] right; \p{L} under :case-insensitive-mode on "1" = 0.
  * bare \pM under a resolver = cl-ppcre SYNTAX ERROR "Expected left brace after \p" (lexer.lisp:280 read-char-property) -> PCL must rewrite \pX -> \p{X} in %pcl-expand-hv-escapes (the one forward scan) BEFORE the engine.
  * a resolver answer of NIL = "The function COMMON-LISP:NIL is undefined" at MATCH time -> the resolver must SIGNAL, never return NIL; the signal rides the ppcre-syntax-error path, which is itself wrong today (#2372: warn + a wrong VALUE; perl dies) -> #2372 is member 0.
  * Unicode versions agree: perl 5.40.3 = 15.0.0; SBCL 2.6.0 sb-unicode age(U+1FAE8) = 15, gc SO.
  * DATA SOURCE = perl`s OWN tables: Unicode::UCD::prop_invlist(NAME) gives the exact inversion list (Word 1,542 ints, M 620); prop_aliases / prop_value_aliases the alias sets; sizing gc 38 lists/12,796 ints + sc 164/3,313 + blk 328/757 + scx 164/3,661 + 97 binary & POSIX classes/39,903 = 791 lists, 60,430 integers (~0.4 MB text; cl/pcl-pack.lisp is 195 KB) -> generated once by tools/rebuild-uniprops into cl/pcl-uniprops.lisp (a FOURTH artifact, no gen= stamp: it depends on perl`s Unicode data, not the compiler), loaded lazily by p-load-extension at the first \p, FASL-cached (#1202).  DO NOT RETRY: hand-mapping derived classes (Word/Alpha/Space/Punct/Graph/Print/ID_Start) onto sb-unicode predicates -- each is a perl-specific formula; sb-unicode is the gc CROSS-CHECK only.  DO NOT approximate an ungenerated property by another (scx by sc etc.): DIE with perl`s text.
  * perl grammar probed (the table is in the brief): loose matching; ^ negation inside braces; Is/In prefixes; name=value and name:value; sc short aliases (Latn); blocks bare when unambiguous (Latin1); Age=/In=/Present_In=; \p{L&}; POSIX vs XPosix; /i: "a" =~ /\P{Lu}/i is 0 in perl (fold THEN complement) while cl-ppcre`s :inverted-property complements first -> rewrite outside-class \P{X} -> [^\p{X}].  Errors at compile, trappable: Can`t find Unicode property definition "X" / Empty \p{} / Unknown user-defined property name \p{main::IsX}.  User-defined: sub IsFoo/InFoo in the current package, returns range text (+utf8::Nd includes) -- member 4, sized first.
  * populations: no everyday/ or Rosetta program spells \p itself; the everyday row is modules/Text-Wrap-ParseWords-Abbrev via core Text::Wrap; core lib spellers: Text/Wrap.pm, Text/Tabs.pm, Term/Table/Cell.pm, Pod/Simple/BlackBox.pm (IsAge=1.1, InIPAExtensions, IsCs, IsCn, IsDeprecated), File/Path.pm, Pod/Simple/RTF.pm, Unicode/UCD.pm, charnames; perl`s t/: 27 files (prop-files.txt), THE file re/regexp_unicode_prop.t 778/332 (IsMyRuntimeProperty x19 = the user-defined measure), op/lc.t 2685/31, uni/class.t 0/12; sweep: perl-tests/lc.t has three \p{IsWord} rows COMMENTED OUT with "PCL: ... Skip" (a rule-5 edit to restore = member 5).
  * also: \X can now take the legacy approximation (?>\r\n|\P{M}\p{M}*|\p{M}+) = member 3.

=== DONE (s496a) ===
\p{...} / \pX / \P{...} answered from PERL'S OWN tables: tools/rebuild-uniprops (prop_invlist for every spelling perl accepts: gc/sc/scx/blk/age/in under all aliases, every bare name in unicore/uni_keywords.pl, =Y/=N, Is forms, the census; _Perl_* internals scanned from perl's regex engine) -> cl/pcl-uniprops.lisp (9,000 keys, 717 lists, 82,950 integers, 706 KB; stamp `unicode=15.0.0 perl=5.40.3`, NO gen=), loaded by a %pcl-def-ext-stub stub at the first property.  %pcl-property-resolver installed globally; never returns NIL; unknown -> trappable die in perl's words via #2372's helper.  Outside a class \p{X} -> [\p{X}], \P{X} -> [^\p{X}] (fold then complement); /i caseless equivalents MEASURED per spelling (Lt/i = Cased, not the hash's LC).  User-defined IsFoo/InFoo subs implemented.  \X = legacy rule (residue #2381).  perl-tests/lc.t's three \p{IsWord} rows restored (rule 5).
Probes: all grammar/breaking/(i) rows identical to perl except the ungenerated ea=W (dies by design).  Text::Wrap wrap/fill/200 words/combining marks + Text::Tabs byte-identical to perl.
Guards: Pl/t/uniprops-01.t (10 rows: stamp, regenerate+cmp, no gen=, gc vs sb-unicode at all 1,114,112 code points = 0 disagreements, normalizer agreement, 5 behaviour programs), regex-extended-mode-01.t row 12 (\X).
Numbers: gate 266/8767 PASS; sweep TOTAL 18690 -> 18693 (lc.t); companion re/regexp_unicode_prop.t 778/332 -> 1003/107, uni/class.t 0/12 -> OK 12/0, op/lc.t 2685/31 -> 2688/28, uni/variables.t TIMEOUT 1300 -> 8272+ ok; EVERYDAY 101 -> 101 (the Text-Wrap row MOVED to #2085: the program now reaches its %{{ abbrev() }} refusal).  Census docs/uniprops-census-s496.tsv 146 spellings.  Docs: docs/regex-unicode-properties.md, ir-spec §10-prop.
subject: cl-ppcre`s *property-resolver* is NEVER SET, so every `\p{...}` / `\pM` silently never matches -- and that, not \X, is what blocks core Text::Wrap under perl 5.40.3
